This is Sigrún, in Grindavik. At three in the morning, she was packing for a flight.
Then the ground opened outside town. Her airline already had a new fare.
Sigrún evacuated in an orderly queue, according to the brochure.
At the shelter, the power went out. Her phone suggested a subscription.
By evening, every flight was grounded. Including hers.
Day two: help from Norway, and a six-hundred-page customs form.
Day three: the power came back. Her flight did not.
